_source: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, 'Estimated Costs of Crop Production in Iowa - 2026', Ag Decision Maker File A1-20 (FM 1712, revised January 2026), middle yield column: corn following soybeans 211 bu/acre (page 3) and herbicide-tolerant soybeans following corn 61 bu/acre (page 5). USD/acre x 2.4711 = USD/ha. Mapping: field_operations = preharvest machinery (fixed + variable); marketing_harvest = harvest machinery incl. haul, dry and handle (fixed + variable); seed; crop_protection = herbicide (+ insecticide where listed); fertilizer = N + P + K + lime; overhead = crop insurance + miscellaneous + labor (2.55 h corn, 2.20 h soybean at $20.40); rent = ISU cash rent equivalent $274/acre. Interest on operating capital is excluded because the engine computes it. Price is a reference; the engine uses the CBOT curve plus basis.
_verified: 2026-10-27 by Claude against the PDF downloaded from extension.iastate.edu/agdm/crops/pdf/a1-20.pdf
_price_point_note: The price is CBOT plus the local Iowa basis (cash bid at the elevator). ISU's harvest machinery cost already includes hauling to that elevator; the trip onward to the Gulf or the Pacific Northwest is inside the basis.
